The ADOT EKS add-on has implicit dependencies on the Role and ClusterRole, but the RoleBinding is also required to grant the add-on manager access. Without ordering after this binding, the add-on may provision before its required permissions are effective.

The ADOT EKS add-on has implicit dependencies on the Role and ClusterRole, but the ClusterRoleBinding is also required to grant the add-on manager cluster-wide access. Without ordering after this binding, the add-on may provision before its required permissions are effective.

For Windows self-managed nodes, the ASG can launch instances before the additional Windows CNI policy is attached to the node role. The ASG should wait for this attachment so nodes do not start without the permissions needed by the Windows CNI.

The EventBridge target can become active before the SQS queue policy grants EventBridge permission to send messages. It should wait for the queue policy so events are not delivered while authorization is absent.
